column3: NASB follows the critical text and joins vv. 31–32 into one sentence (“all seven died, leaving no children”); “took” is rendered “married.”
NASB has no separate text here; it marks the verse “(SEE v. 31),” having joined it to v. 31. The death of the woman is placed there.
NASB follows the critical text without “answering.”
NASB follows the critical text; “obtain” is rendered “attain to.”
NASB follows the critical text; it adds “even” and “because.”
NASB renders “at the bush” as “in the passage about the burning bush”; the quotation is in capitals.
NASB follows the critical text; “daring” is rendered “have courage.”
NASB follows the critical text; the quotation is in capitals.
Close to the Greek; “place” is rendered “make,” in capitals.
NASB has “the disciples,” though the critical text has “His.”
NASB adds “respectful”; “first seats” is rendered “chief seats,” and “first places” is “places of honor.”
NASB renders “as a pretext” as “for appearance’s sake.”
